theorems.name: Submission.gwe_graph_tangential_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → closedBall 0 σ ⊆ U → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) (σ / 2), ‖f x‖ ≤ σ / 16) → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall 0 σ, infDist x (rotatedPlane q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ σ / 16) → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∀ x' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 2), x = q (graphPoint x' (f x')) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x' → V.tangentProj x = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ f x' v)))).starProjection) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 (σ / 4) → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x, ‖gradient ζ x‖ ≤ M) → ∀ j : Fin ℓ, |∫ x in q '' graphOver f (ball 0 (σ / 4)), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm x)).1) (gradient ζ (EuclideanSpace.finAddEquivProd (q.symm x)).1) ∂V.weight| ≤ M * (V.weight (closedBall 0 (σ / 2) ∩ (V.support \ q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2))))).toReal + M * ∫ x in closedBall 0 σ, hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection) ∂V.weight + M * (σ / 4) * ∫ x in closedBall 0 (σ / 2), ‖H x‖ ∂V.weight
